department: Department of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

funding.value: All applicants are considered for support, and admitted Ph.D. students are generally fully funded (fellowships, TA or research posts); M.S. students get no department funding.
funding.quote: All applicants will be considered for financial support. In general, our admitted Ph.D. students are fully funded through fellowships and grants, teaching assistant, and/or graduate student research (GSR) opportunities.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's in atmospheric science or a related field (physics, maths, engineering, chemistry and others).
entry_route.quote: In addition to applicants who hold a bachelor's degree in meteorology or atmospheric sciences, those with a degree in related disciplines, such as astronomy, chemistry, engineering, geophysics, oceanography, mathematics, and physics, are also encouraged to apply.
